n: Raspberry Pi Foundation Introduction to Pico learning path
t: A six-project path for learning MicroPython with the Raspberry Pi Pico.
steps: Find the Getting started with Pico path on the Raspberry Pi Foundation site.
Buy a Pico and the parts, such as the kit named on the blog.
Follow the first two projects to set up.
Check the project gallery rules before students share.
Work through the path in order.
